title: Unexpected SAML assertion truncation causes short-lived impersonation window; urgent KMS rewrap + audit backfill
creator: Asha Patel
description: Several enterprise customers reported an unusual access window where SSO-authenticated sessions could act as a different tenant for up to ~45 seconds. Root cause: an assertion trimming step in the SAML intake pipeline removed trailing attributes on large assertion payloads, which combined with a concurrent KMS rewrap job that rotated the assertion envelope key to produce a short race during session materialization. During the race, some identity attributes (tenant_id and role_claims) were interpreted as null and the RBAC binder applied a fallback permissive rule for legacy tenants. Additionally, the audit pipeline batches events into 1s buckets; events that hit the race path were deduped by the batch key and dropped, leading to incomplete audit trails. This ticket covers the urgent patch to the SAML intake sanitizer, a KMS job coordination fix (prevent rewrap during active assertion processing), a compensating audit backfill job, and customer communications.
updates: 2026-03-10: Customer 'AcmeAnalytics' opened P0 escalation reporting cross-tenant reads during overnight load test. Triage confirmed reproduction in staging with synthetic SAML payloads.
2026-03-11: Root cause identified: assertion trimming function shortened large SAML attributes during header sanitization. Observed correlation with rewraps from nightly KMS maintenance job at scale.
2026-03-11: Mitigation deployed: temporarily disable assertion trimming sanitizer and add defensive null-checks in RBAC binder. Rollout to affected private clusters completed within 2 hours.

2026-03-12: Hotfix branch opened (github.com/redwood-inference/priv-identity/PR-1493). Patch includes: preserve full SAML attribute payload, add per-assertion rewrap lock, and increase audit batch dedupe window from 1s to 5s while we backfill.

2026-03-13: Deployed KMS rewrap coordination service to two canary private clusters; monitored for 6 hours—no regressions observed. Audit backfill job prototype validated against the incident logs for AcmeAnalytics.

2026-03-14: Customer communication drafted and shared with Solutions and Support. Planned full rollout to all impacted private clusters on 2026-03-17 during maintenance window. Postmortem owners assigned.
comments: Diego Marquez (eng): Recommending we keep rewrap lock as default for any assertion-processing endpoint until we complete the concurrency redesign. Lock introduces minor tail-latency increase but prevents state inconsistency.
Lina Chen (sec): Requesting immediate security review for the hotfix branch. Need KMS usage matrix and threat model update before GA.
Marcus O'Neill (support): Noted two other customers (FinPort, MediCloud) have reported similar but intermittent symptoms; adding them to incident notification list.
Asha Patel (pm): Coordinate release notes with Legal for regulated customers. Push to postpone non-essential nightly rewraps for next 48 hours.
QA: Running assertion fuzzing harness across saml-variants; found one additional edge case where large XML comments triggered sanitizer path — included in patch.
Infra: Audit backfill job will use time-windowed replays from raw ingress logs; will tag backfilled events with 'replay=true' to avoid double-counting analytics.
